Changed: Reviews re-check settled decisions that cut scope ("only these 16 settings") against the ticket, smoke test or mock-up on a first review, instead of never raising them again.

whats_new.title: Scope cuts get re-checked
whats_new.text: A decision that left something out stays settled on re-reviews, but a first review checks it against the ticket and smoke test, flags it when they disagree, and lists the rest under Known scope cuts.
